title: Spend over time: which chats spent tokens, hour by hour

steps.caption: Spend over time: the last 24 hours' tokens, stacked by the chat that spent them
Hovering an hour says which chats spent in it
Picking it lists them: tokens by kind, turns, purpose and cost; each opens its ticket or chat
A chat in the legend lists what it spent, hour by hour
Over 7 days, by day, in dollars
